name: Gender and Sexuality
description: An introduction to historicist, feminist, psychoanalytical and legal ways of understanding gender and sexuality. We will discuss some of the most important ways of conceptually differentiating between these two terms, and pay attention to what might be at stake in this difference. We will also study the relation between philosophical/theoretical discussions, legal debates, and public discourse centering on gender and sexuality, both in India and elsewhere.
